raw_policy_excerpt:
# Rewards
MercadoLibre offers rewards to eligible reporters for qualifying vulnerabilities, with a minimum reward of $50 USD. All bounties for High and Critical reports are calculated using CVSS 3.1 via (((CVSS Score x Tier) x Severity) + Loyalty Bonus) = Bounty total. Constants: TIER 1 = 100, TIER 2 = 50, HIGH/CRITICAL = 10. Lows/mids fixed per bounty table. Low only if CVSS >= 2.0. Loyalty bonuses: Newbie 25%, Antique 4-10% (consecutive years), Fix Bypass +10%.

# Tier 3 Non-Applicative Vulnerabilities
Eligible when ALL met: (1) non-applicative (misconfig/access-control/asset-management - not app code); (2) asset demonstrably linked to MercadoLibre; (3) fix is config/access change; (4) NO exploitation beyond confirmation - reporter MUST NOT have accessed, exfiltrated, or used exposed data beyond confirming existence. Single non-destructive API call to validate creds OK; going further is not. Severity: Critical $1000 / High $750 / Medium $200 / Low $75. One bounty per source location.

# Eligibility and Responsible Disclosure (Safe Harbor)
Mercado Libre does not intend to take legal action or initiate law enforcement investigations against security researchers who adhere to: report without making info public until mutual agreement; allow reasonable time to resolve before publishing (ML follows HackerOne disclosure guidelines, 30-day initial response); make good-faith efforts to avoid destroying, stealing, modifying, damaging, or jeopardizing personal data/privacy of ML customers or disrupting products and services.

# Restrictions (PROHIBITED)
- Automated Scanning: Massive automated scans are not permitted. Creative testing is encouraged instead.
- Test Users: Improper/out-of-scope use may result in ban.
- Service Degradation may lead to ban.
- No DoS Attacks: prohibited by cloud providers.
- Physical Attacks against ML employees/offices/data centers prohibited.
- Social Engineering of ML employees/contractors/vendors/providers (including phishing) prohibited.
- Spam prohibited.
- Account Compromise of other ML customer/employee accounts forbidden.
- Malware delivery to ML or employees prohibited.
- Mass Account Creation prohibited.
- Brute Force Testing for rate-limiting determination prohibited.
- Internal employees prohibited; former employees only after 1-year waiting period; providers/affiliated entities prohibited.

# Considerations
(a) Code Review/SAST: avoid uploading automatic scanning tool results; 0-day and other CVE vulnerabilities may be reported 30 days after initial publication (CVE List status of Published); CVEs/0-days/working exploits must be demonstrable through the internet with proper PoC; dependency confusion is out-of-scope; supply chain attacks via maliciously-published public-registry packages demonstrably affecting ML build/runtime are in-scope with working PoC.
(b) Third-party apps must be exploitable on ML infra; out-of-date libs without PoC are out-of-scope; third-party scripts on ML websites are out-of-scope.
(c) Mobile: do NOT report cert pinning/SSL-TLS best practices, obfuscated code, SafetyNet/anti-instrumentation/anti-tamper/root detection, exported components w/o security impact, or arbitrary-domain loads via mercadopago://in-app-browser/?url=$URL or meli://in-app-browser/?url=$URL (in-app browser treats externals as untrusted by design).
(d) Subdomain takeover: must be possible to insert content; demonstrate with verification page, DNS (CNAME/A), provider, claim steps, HTTP/HTTPS captures; do NOT steal cookies or interact with users; no phishing.
(e) XSS without CSP bypass receives lower/no severity vs XSS with bypass. Any .cn domain (e.g. *.mercadolibre.cn) is excluded from scope. ML reserves the right to modify the program, evaluate scope tiers, and escalate Tier 3 to Tier 2 or Tier 1 based on assessed business impact.
